title: 재외공관주재무관의 대외직명에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00010:part:1/1

ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Rule No. 1, Mar. 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (12) Omitted.

(13) The Rules on External Official Titles of Military Attachés Stationed at Diplomatic Missions Abroad are partially amended as follows:

In Article 3 (1), "Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade" is replaced with "Minister of Foreign Affairs".

(14) through (18) Omitted.
